final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS state_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(state_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.state_count), AVG(s.state_count - o.avg_count) FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND s.state_count > o.avg_count
